purpose: Review a GBIF-indexed Smithsonian USNM eel specimen record from Basco, Batanes as historical freshwater-labeled collection evidence while withholding unverified coordinates, named-waterbody identity, present-day status, and public projection.

source.provider: National Museum of Natural History, Smithsonian Institution, via GBIF

reproducibleScreen.queryDescription: GBIF occurrence search filtered to country PH, stateProvince Batanes, coordinates present, and GBIF accepted taxon key 5213048 for Anguilla marmorata.
reproducibleScreen.screenLimit: A live indexed-search count is reproducible only as a dated discovery screen. It is not an exhaustive Batanes fish inventory, a completeness measure, or evidence that no other records exist.

broaderActinopterygiiScreen.taxonomy: Catalogue of Life eXtended Release checklist Actinopterygii, checklist key 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b and taxon key 8VR36
broaderActinopterygiiScreen.freshwaterTextMatch: GBIF ID 1320849822, USNM 331725; the same specimen reviewed here.
broaderActinopterygiiScreen.interpretation: Bounded free-text queries within coordinate-bearing COL XR Actinopterygii records do not classify habitat, exclude uncoordinated records, and do not show that Batanes has no rivers, lakes, streams, or other freshwater fish records.

record.locality: Freshwater eel, Basco, 1 kilometer south of

taxonomyCrosscheck.finding: The current Catalog of Fishes record treats Anguilla marmorata as valid. GBIF also returns this specimen under accepted species key 5213048.
taxonomyCrosscheck.limit: The taxon status is a nomenclatural cross-check, not an independent re-identification of USNM 331725. The GBIF record has no identifiedBy value, and the NMNH item detail was not independently retrieved in this review.

localityAndCoordinateAssessment.geographicScopeSupported: Basco, Batanes, as stated in the source locality; this is separate from Itbayat Island.
localityAndCoordinateAssessment.freshwaterContext: The source locality explicitly calls the specimen a freshwater eel, but does not name the river, stream, spring, wetland, lake, or exact collection site.
localityAndCoordinateAssessment.geodeticDatumIssue: GBIF reports GEODETIC_DATUM_ASSUMED_WGS84. The coordinates have two decimal places and no uncertainty radius; the source record does not support precision mapping.
localityAndCoordinateAssessment.coordinateDisposition: Retain the values only in this research review; do not map, reverse-geocode, or convert them into waterbody geometry or a fishing location.

qualityAndReuseLimits: This is one dated preserved-specimen record, not a recent survey, abundance estimate, population status, complete Batanes checklist, or fishing/catchability guide.
The locality suggests freshwater origin and Basco, but no exact waterbody or capture reach can be assigned from this label.
Do not link this Batan/Basco specimen to Kayaywan or Kavaywan Lake, the unnamed Reale/Raele lake, Itbayat, or the provincial 22-hectare lake.
The record carries a GBIF coordinate-datum assumption and no uncertainty value; coordinates are not suitable for a public map.
No diet, bait, legal-access, safety, present-day presence, or abundance claim is derived.
The GBIF dataset and this occurrence record are marked CC0-1.0, but that does not approve public projection under Bangwit's evidence and review policy. No image or media is used.

decision.reasonHeld: Preserved specimen and freshwater/Basco source locality are useful historical evidence, but no site-level waterbody or coordinate uncertainty is supplied, and current presence is not established.

nextAction: Keep the USNM record as a province-level historical lead. Continue public-source searching for named Batanes rivers, lakes, springs, or wetlands with independent fish survey records; do not transfer this Basco specimen to Itbayat waterbodies or infer absence from a bounded search.
